mapper.sql: d.id, d.dish_name, d.category_id, d.price, d.stock, d.cover_img, d.taste_tag, d.description, d.status, d.create_time, d.update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_dish ( merchant_id, dish_name, category_id, price, stock, cover_img, taste_tag, description, status ) VALUES ( #{merchantId}, #{dishName}, #{categoryId}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{coverImg}, #{tasteTag}, #{description}, 1 )
mapper.select: SELECT , c.category_name FROM t_dish d LEFT JOIN t_dish_category c ON d.category_id = c.id AND c.merchant_id = #{merchantId} WHERE d.merchant_id = #{merchantId} ORDER BY d.create_time DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM t_dish WHERE id = #{id} AND merchant_id = #{merchantId}
